title: Slay the Spire
description: Turn-based, but each run is a long chain of decisions. Benchmarks report win rates; here a single submitted run counts, so state the character and Ascension level.
clear_condition: Defeat the Act 3 boss (standard victory). The Corrupt Heart is a post-game milestone.
rules: Any character, any Ascension level (state both). One run per submission; for win rates, link the full set of runs in notes.

attempts.name: SpireBench
attempts.team: Scott C. Lowe (Vector Institute) and Sander W. Keemink (Radboud University)
attempts.team_zh: Scott C. Lowe（Vector 研究所）与 Sander W. Keemink（拉德堡德大学）
attempts.result: Twenty LLMs play the Ironclad at Ascension 20 through a mod that sends the game state as text, 10 runs each on held-out seeds. 4 of the 200 runs beat the Act 3 boss: Claude Fable 5.1 twice, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol once each, and the Sol run went on to kill the Heart. For comparison, human players average 0.73 acts cleared and the expert Baalorlord 2.98.
attempts.result_zh: 20 个 LLM 通过一个把游戏状态转成文本的模组，用铁甲战士在进阶 20 下游玩，每个模型在预留种子上跑 10 局。200 局中有 4 局击败了第三幕 Boss：Claude Fable 5.1 两次，GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 各一次，其中 Sol 那局还击杀了腐化之心。作为对比，人类玩家平均通过 0.73 幕，高手 Baalorlord 平均 2.98 幕。
attempts.why_not: Those four winning runs would rank here, but none is public: the runs were logged to Weights & Biases with no public link.
attempts.why_not_zh: 这 4 局胜利本可以上榜，但都没有公开：运行记录存在 Weights & Biases 上，没有公开链接。

attempts.name: SpireClimb
attempts.result: Models play the normal game from screenshots, 15 single attempts per model, character and game. At Ascension 0, GPT-6 Astra wins 98% of runs, GPT-6.1 Sol 97% and Claude Opus 5.5 93%. At Ascension 20 with the Heart required, the best is GPT-6.1 Sol at 20%. Slay the Spire 2 is tested too.
attempts.result_zh: 模型看截图玩原版游戏，每个模型、每个角色、每款游戏各尝试 15 次。进阶 0 下，GPT-6 Astra 胜率 98%，GPT-6.1 Sol 97%，Claude Opus 5.5 93%。进阶 20 且要求击杀腐化之心时，最好的是 GPT-6.1 Sol，20%。同时也测试了《杀戮尖塔 2》。
attempts.why_not: Reports win rates over many runs; no single run is published with a log or video to check.
attempts.why_not_zh: 只报告多局的胜率，没有公开任何一局可供核对的日志或录像。
